comment.narrative: 02-04-2024: Methodology for Calculating Current Unique Users:1. Calculate Monthly Repeat Filter Paper Sales: Last month's filter paper sales - funnel sales.(Excluding monthly 1st time purchasers; Door-to-door and market-based activations observed purchasers buying one filter paper along with a funnel in their 1st trial purchase)2. Calculate no. of Active Paying Customers in a Month: Divide monthly repeat filter paper sales by estimated filter papers a customer buys monthly. (Ref: January 2024 survey of 116 active paying customers found they buy ~2(1.99) filter papers/week, thus 8 filter papers/month, average customer tenure 1.8 months).3. Calculate the Total Number of Current Unique Users: Multiply the number of active paying customers in a month by the number of family members drinking from Folia Filters. (Ref: January 2024 survey found 3.5 family members drink Folia filtered water in an active paying customer's household)Bangladesh Population Male: Female Ratio = 51.7% : 48.3%

3-09-2024: Methodology for Calculating Current Unique Users:1. Calculate Monthly Repeat Filter Paper Sales: Last months filter paper sales - funnel sales = (25,225 units)(Excluding monthly 1st time purchasers; Door-to-door and market-based activations observed purchasers buying one filter paper along with a funnel in their 1st trial purchase)2. Calculate no. of Active Paying Customers in a Month: Divide monthly repeat filter paper sales by estimated filter papers a customer buys in a month = (25,225 units/8) = 3,153 regular customers)(Ref: January 2024 survey of 116 active paying customers found they buy ~2(1.99) filter papers/week, thus 8 filter papers/month, average customer tenure 1.8 months)3. Calculate Total Number of Current Unique Users: Multiply the number of active paying customers in a month by the number of family members drinking from Folia Filters. = (3,153*3.5 members) = 11,036 unique users(Ref: January 2024 survey found 3.5 family members drink Folia filtered water in an active paying customer's household)Bangladesh Population Male: Female Ratio = 51.7% : 48.3% = 5,706 : 5,330

title.narrative: Please provide a short narrative explanation of the data here. (max 250 words)

actual.value: We conducted an end-line survey among 530 repeat customers across Jashore (42%) and the Dhaka periphery (58%) to assess the impact of Folia filters. Additionally, 92 respondents (17%) were surveyed to capture care workers' perspectives. The findings show an increase in both consumption and the number of household members using Folia filters, especially among those using them for over three months. On average, households now purchase 2.35 filter paper units per week, up from 1.99 units in 2023. About 79% of respondents reported buying 2 to 3 filter papers weekly, with the average number of users per household rising from 3.5 to 3.7. The survey also revealed a reduction in monthly medicinal costs by BDT 244 (EUR 2.01) for repeat customers, with higher savings in Jashore (EUR 2.75) compared to the Dhaka periphery (EUR 1.47). Those using Folia filters for over six months saved even more (EUR 3.06). Additionally, 35% adopted better sanitation and hygiene practices, potentially reducing costs further. We also measured a reduction in time for water collection. Women care workers reduced their daily water collection time, including queuing, from 26 minutes to 15 minutes, saving 11 minutes daily.
